description: Stay in this stunning 150 m² apartment just steps from the Arc de Triomphe and the Champs‑Élysées. Fully renovated and equipped with central air conditioning, it offers three spacious bedrooms with en‑suite bathrooms and a bright living area with a balcony. Perfect for an elegant Parisian stay with family or friends. Please note, constructions work in the building next door. Disturbances can happen during working hours. End by end of 2025.The spaceDiscover this spacious apartment featuring:* Entrance hall leading to a large living and dining area with balcony* Separate fully equipped kitchen* Master bedroom: queen-size bed, walk-in closet, TV, and en‑suite bathroom (shower and WC)* Second bedroom: queen-size bed, walk-in closet, TV, and en‑suite bathroom (bathtub, shower, and WC)* Third bedroom: queen-size bed, walk-in closet, TV, and en‑suite bathroom (bathtub, shower, and WC)* Sofa bed in the living room* Separate toilet* Laundry with washer/dryerGuest accessFull access to the apartment for a fully independent stay..Other things to note* 150 sqm (1614 sq.ft)* High-speed Wi-Fi* Elevator access* Baby crib provided* Central air conditioning* Three bedrooms + one sofa bed (8 guests)* Bed linen, towels, and toiletries provided* Private driver / airport transfer on request* Please note: construction work in the neighbouring building may cause some daytime noisePlease contact us for any additional requests.We look forward to hosting you!
